verdict.rationale: Airweave exposes a standard MCP server so any MCP-capable assistant (Claude, Cursor, etc.) can query the same synced knowledge, and ships official skills for Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode, with community confirmation that Cursor integration works well. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/evidence of ChatGPT connecting via MCP or plugins, and independent proof that multiple different assistants actually share the same live memory simultaneously.
